cultural.vision_reason: The image shows an Innu-made "tea doll" with a baby, featuring tanned hide face, hide moccasins, mitten harness, and cloth clothing with floral patterns—a traditional craft item explicitly attributed to Innu makers.

physical.title: doll
physical.summary: Tea doll with baby. Cloth doll (a) stuffed with tea with black yarn hair and red and black felt hat. Floral patterned cloth dress and apron; tanned hide face with black embroidered features, tanned hide hair ties with blue, red and white seed beads, tanned hide boot soles with cotton uppers, and hide mitten harness attached to cloth mitts. Baby doll (b) with hide face, black embroidery features; wrapped in cloth blankets and tied with tanned hide cradle board.
